note: the zigzag table swaps entries 1 and 2, so a coefficient lands on the wrong frequency, caught by JPEGReadTests.zigzag
a restart marker keeps the DC predictions instead of resetting them to 0, caught by JPEGReadTests.restartResetsDC
the JPEG block bound lets any block count through, so a short stub allocates its coefficient store before failing, caught by JPEGReadGuardTests.blockBoundNamed
the JPEG SOF height 0 (height from DNL) is let through instead of unsupported, caught by JPEGReadGuardTests.heightFromDNL
the JPEG interleaved scan limit of 10 blocks per MCU is dropped, caught by JPEGReadGuardTests.mcuOver10Blocks
the JPEG reader's maxPixels guard lets any pixel count through, caught by JPEGReadTests.refusesHuge
the JPEG progressive block bound is 384 blocks a byte again, so 1,000 bytes size a 49,152-block store, caught by JPEGReadGuardTests.progressiveBlockBoundTight
the JPEG second SOF is let through, so a bigger frame swaps in after the store was sized, caught by JPEGReadGuardTests.secondSOF
the JPEG walk drops its overrun check, so a scan with no bytes decodes from padding, caught by JPEGReadGuardTests.shortScanNamed
the JPEG EXIF Orientation is not clamped to 1...8, so 9 is reported, caught by JPEGReadGuardTests.exifOrientationOutOfRange
